## Load in Data

### Normalized quant file

```{r}
quant <- read.csv("09012026_A47mxaF_Ln_limitation_iimn_gnps_quant.csv", header=T, check.names=F)

```

### Metadata

```{r}
md <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T, check.names = F, sep = ',')
```

## Cleanup code

### Transpose the quant table

```{r}
quant <- t(quant)
quant <- as.data.frame(quant)

new_colnames <- as.character(quant[1, ])
quant <- quant[-1,]

colnames(quant) <- new_colnames

quant <- quant[grep(".mzML", rownames(quant)), ]


```

```{r}
numeric_columns <- sapply(quant, is.numeric)
numeric_columns

convert_to_numeric <- function(column) {
  as.numeric(as.character(column))
}

# Apply the function to all columns
quant <- quant %>% mutate_all(convert_to_numeric)
```

```{r}
quant <- quant %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("filename")

quant$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", quant$filename)
```

### Merge feature table and metadata for plotting

```{r}
data_merge <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "Sample_Name") %>% 
  left_join(quant, by = "filename")



```



### Subset media blank and extraction blank

```{r}
data_merge <- data_merge %>% filter(Sample_Name != "Blank")

```

### Set level to plot

```{r}
data_merge$Sample_Name <- factor(data_merge$Sample_Name, levels = c("Lanthanum_chloride_added", "Lanthanum_oxide_added","No_lanthanum"))
```


```{r}

data_merge $metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st <- data_merge $`6521` / data_merge $`1530`

```

```{r}
data_6521_normalized <- data_merge %>%
  select(filename, `metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st`)

data_6521_normalized <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "Sample_Name") %>% 
  left_join(data_6521_normalized, by = "filename")

data_6521_normalized  <- data_6521_normalized  %>%
  filter(!is.na(`metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st`) & trimws(as.character(`metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st`)) != "")

```

```{r}
kruskal.test(`metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st` ~ Sample_Name, data = data_6521_normalized)

```
```{r}
shapiro.test(data_6521_normalized$metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st)
```
```{r}
anova_model <- aov(
  metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st ~ Sample_Name,
  data = data_6521_normalized
)

summary(anova_model)

TukeyHSD(anova_model)
```

```{r}

data_merge <- data_merge %>%
  filter(Sample_Name != "Lanthanum_oxide_added")
```


```{r}
metallophore_784mz <- data_merge %>%
  tail(60) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x= Sample_Name, y= `6521`)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size= 3) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(y= "Peak area (AU)", x= expression(paste("")), shape ="")+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust =1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color= "black"),
        axis.line=element_line(size =1),
        axis.ticks=element_line(size=1), 
        axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14,family="sans"))

plot(metallophore_784mz)
ggsave(file="metallophore_731_proton_adduct.png", plot=metallophore_784mz, width =4, height = 5 )
```

```{r}
wilcox.test(metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st ~ Sample_Name, data = data_merge)
```
```{r}
kruskal.test(metallophore_normalized_to_ext_st ~ Sample_Name, data = data_merge)
```
